description:
FILED s523 (Fable, 2026-10-20 21:1x) from reading the Actions API for the first time in weeks: the PAUSE files' "CI green" lines only ever read the `CI` workflow.  FACTS: `install-matrix` (weekly, cron 20 5 * * 1 + pushes touching .github/workflows/install-matrix.yml or tools/install-matrix/**) was GREEN on its schedules of 2026-09-21, 09-28, 10-05, 10-12 (b91b8867) and RED on the push run of 2026-10-17 08:00 UTC (9452c5db; the trigger = 758bb795, s517b's tools/install-matrix/verify.sh +9 lines: a `use Compress::Zlib` memGzip / memGunzip round trip under the INSTALLED runpcl, #3161) and on the schedule of 2026-10-19 10:54 UTC (885a8fda).  Two matrix jobs ran, both `Fresh-machine install + verify (the shared recipe)` FAILED at step 4 (the whole recipe: deps.sh + install-pcl + verify.sh), the other two matrix entries did not appear (fail-fast).  The logs endpoint answers 403 unauthenticated; `gh` is unauthed on this box -- THE USER CAN READ https://github.com/Percolisp/pcl/actions/runs/39240788339 (and 39170840489 is the green CI run of the same sha).  MEASURED LOCALLY (s523, review/install-container-s523.log): `prove -v tools/t/install-container.t` at 8038fac6 = Result: PASS 17/17 in 97 s, REUSING the cached base image pcl-install-base:75e4154ef129 (deps.sh hash + SBCL_VERSION) -- so the verify half INCLUDING the gzip step passes in a container here; both ubuntu:24.04 and debian:12 ship libz.so.1 (podman ls) and the runtime loads it lazily (%p-host-library-p).  What the local run did NOT exercise: a FRESH deps.sh (apt + cpanm PPI + the SBCL binary download from sbcl.org / sourceforge) -- the image was cached.  NEXT (the discriminator, 5 min): run deps.sh fresh in a throwaway container with network; if it fails, the cause is a download / mirror change (fix = the mirror / a pinned URL in deps.sh); if it passes, the failure is runner-specific and the USER's log is the only instrument.  Not a PCL correctness bug; a RELEASE / portability item (USER: "not software for our laptop" -- the install matrix is the portability bar).

UPDATE (s523, 21:2x): the failing step's TAIL is public -- `tools/ci-step` writes it as a `::error::` annotation, readable at https://api.github.com/repos/Percolisp/pcl/check-runs/118020806743/annotations (and 118020807045).  Both jobs die in the verify.sh gzip step: `runpcl /tmp/gz.pl` -> `(P-USE "Compress::Zlib")` -> P-LOAD-MODULE-CACHED -> %P-LOAD-MODULE-UNCACHED -> %P-LOAD-TEXT-STREAM -> LOAD of /tmp/pcl-nocache-*.lisp -> an unhandled condition (`--disable-debugger`); the condition text is above the 24-line tail the annotation keeps (ci-step could keep the FIRST lines of the error too -- the message is what matters, not the frames 72-95).  So: the stock perl's Compress::Zlib (IO-Compress 2.106 on ubuntu:22.04 / 2.204 on 24.04) does not LOAD through the installed pl2cl on the runners, on code before s521e (whose #3521 changed how IO::Compress::Base::Common's facts overlay declares package U64 + exports).  Local: ubuntu:24.04 at 8038fac6 PASSES 17/17 incl. the gzip step.  Discriminators queued s523: the test at aff112d7 (pre-s521e) and on ubuntu:22.04 / SBCL 2.5.2 at 8038fac6.  Also: tools/ci-step should emit the error MESSAGE (the lines before the backtrace), not only the backtrace tail -- a small fix for whoever takes this.

MEASURED (s523, 21:0x): the local container test at aff112d7 (the code BEFORE s521e) on ubuntu:24.04 also PASSES 17/17 with the gzip step, and a fresh deps.sh on ubuntu:24.04 passes (SBCL 2.6.0 download + cpanm PPI fine) -- so neither s521e nor the downloads discriminate.  Remaining candidates: the IMAGE (ubuntu:22.04 = perl 5.34 + IO-Compress 2.106 + SBCL 2.5.2; the matrix's first job) -- being measured -- or something runner-specific (the GitHub container step's HOME / user / /tmp).

CAUSE FOUND (s523, 21:4x): `PCL_CONTAINER_BASE=ubuntu:22.04 SBCL_VERSION=2.5.2 prove -v tools/t/install-container.t` at 8038fac6 REPRODUCES it (review/install-container-2204.log, legs b/c pass, leg a fails in the gzip step): under SBCL 2.5.2 the first `pack` call compiles the pack artifact and dies `sb-vm::move-double-float-arg is not the name of a defined VOP` -- an SBCL-2.5.2-only compiler error on an emitted shape, i.e. THE SUPPORTED FLOOR IS BROKEN -> #3528 (the fix + the bisect recipe).  The 24.04 / 2.6.0 legs pass because 2.6.0 has the VOP.  This task stays open for TWO things once #3528 lands: (1) `tools/ci-step` keeps the backtrace TAIL and drops the MESSAGE (the first lines) -- keep the head too; (2) the PAUSE / session protocol reads only the `CI` workflow: add the `install-matrix` workflow's latest conclusion to the CI check (the API call is in PAUSE-s523).

=== s523c (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-20): residue 1 DONE, residue 2 handed to Fable ===
Residue 1: commit 60988c6d -- tools/ci-step emits the first error-shaped line above the 40-line tail window, with the dozen lines after it, as its own annotation ("<step>: the error"); an error already inside the tail is not repeated.  tools/t/ci-step.t 10 -> 14 rows.
Residue 2 (the "CI green" check reads the install-matrix workflow too) lives in briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s473/COMMON.md and the PAUSE files, which a batch never commits: the line to add is in s523c STOP.md / residue2.txt (`curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/Percolisp/pcl/actions/workflows/346889006/runs?per_page=1` -> .workflow_runs[0].conclusion).  review/ULTRA-REVIEW-HOWTO.md carries no CI API call at all (grepped), so nothing to amend there.  #3528 (the cause of the red) is DONE on the s523c branch; the matrix turns green only after the merge + push.


=== s523c (s524 resume): residue 1 is commit b60764e0 after the rebase (60988c6d above is pre-rebase).  The #3528 fix passes both container legs (22.04/2.5.2 17/17, 24.04 17/17); this task closes on the install-matrix workflow green after the merge + push (Fable).


CLOSED s524 (Fable, 2026-10-22 01:5x): the install-matrix workflow ran on the MAIN-READY-42 push (bb335a40 = 0f7fc8bd + notes; the push was made to re-run it by a comment line in .github/workflows/install-matrix.yml, since the floor fix lives in cl/ outside the path filter) and completed SUCCESS -- the first green matrix since 2026-10-17 (#3528 fixed the floor; residue 1 = ci-step message annotation, b60764e0; residue 2 = the both-workflows sentence in briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s473/COMMON.md, applied by Fable on main).  Rule now on record: CI green means BOTH workflows.
subject: CI: the install-matrix workflow is RED since 2026-10-17 on every image (step 4 = the whole shared recipe) while the local container test passes 17/17 -- the job log needs the USER (gh unauthed); discriminate deps.sh (network downloads) from install + verify
